c.tagline: Garden Route beach town with white-sand bays, seal colonies, and Big Five safari lodges nearby

card: Widely accepted in town; cash useful for markets and beach vendors

taxi.fare: Negotiated or metered depending on operator
taxi.fareNote: Confirm the fare upfront or use a ride-hailing app

emergency.note: 112 from any mobile phone reaches all emergency services

english.label: Easy to get by in English

walk: Central Plett and the main beach are walkable; Robberg, Keurbooms, and the game reserves require a car

safety.safety: Generally safe for tourists in central and beach areas, though petty crime occurs as in most South African towns
safety.crime: Avoid isolated beach areas after dark and secure valuables in vehicles

hood_landmark.Central Plett / Main Beach: Central Beach and the Plettenberg Bay harbor
hood_landmark.Keurbooms: The Keurbooms River estuary and lagoon
hood_landmark.The Crags: Monkeyland and Birds of Eden sanctuaries

avoid.reason: Do not walk through outlying townships such as Kwanokuthula unaccompanied — visit only with a local guide.
Don't leave valuables on beaches or visible in cars, and avoid deserted beaches and roads after dark.

hood_desc: The compact town center and main beach with restaurants, shops, and the harbor; the natural base for most visitors.
An upscale beachfront strip of clifftop homes and holiday villas along a wide sandy bay, popular for swimming and sunbathing.
A quieter riverside area east of town with the Keurbooms estuary, popular for canoeing and lagoon cruises.
A scenic headland just outside the center known for whale-watching from the rocks in season.
A forested area outside town home to Monkeyland and Birds of Eden wildlife sanctuaries, more a day-trip stop than a place to stay.

water.note: Municipal tap water is generally safe to drink; bottled is widely available if unsure.

transit.sys: No formal municipal bus network; minibus taxis serve local routes
transit.hours: Minibus taxis run roughly daylight hours
transit.map: Not centrally published; ask locally for minibus taxi routes
transit.note: Most visitors rent a car, since Garden Route sights are spread out along the N2

transport.air: Plettenberg Bay Airport (PBZ) has limited seasonal flights; George Airport (GRJ) roughly 45 min away has more regular service
transport.train: No passenger rail service to Plettenberg Bay
transport.bus: Greyhound, Intercape, and Baz Bus (backpacker hop-on-hop-off) connect along the Garden Route
transport.car: A rental car is strongly recommended for exploring the Garden Route; driving is on the left

airport.name: George Airport (main regional gateway)
airport.transport: Rental car, pre-booked transfer, or shuttle

net.m: Good 4G coverage in town, patchier in outlying nature reserves
net.w: Free wifi standard in hotels and cafes
net.fwn: Free wifi widely available in hotels and cafes
net.ap: A Vodacom or MTN tourist SIM or eSIM

tip.s: 10% is customary for tour guides and drivers
